title: Separable residue field: the cotangent space injects into the differentials
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $(R,\mathfrak m,\kappa)$ a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] which is a $k$-algebra, with residue field $\kappa=R/\mathfrak m$, a field extension of $k$ via $k\to R\to\kappa$ [def-pc-field-extension]. Assume $\kappa$ is finitely generated as a field over $k$ ($\kappa=k(a_1,\dots,a_n)$ for finitely many $a_i\in\kappa$) and separable over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-separable-field-extension]. Let $\Omega_{R/k}$ and $\mathrm d:R\to\Omega_{R/k}$ be the module of Kähler differentials and the universal derivation [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. Then the $\kappa$-linear map $$\mathfrak m/\mathfrak m^2\longrightarrow\Omega_{R/k}\otimes_R\kappa,\qquad a\bmod\mathfrak m^2\longmapsto\mathrm da\otimes1\quad(a\in\mathfrak m),$$ is injective.

proof.text: Apply separability to the finitely generated top intermediate field. Unpack its separating transcendence basis s. Mathlib Algebra.FormallySmooth.of_algebraicIndependent_of_isSeparable shows that this top intermediate field is formally smooth over k; transport along IntermediateField.topEquiv to obtain formal smoothness of the residue field κ.

Let f : R → κ be the surjective residue algebra map and q = f.kerSquareLift : R/(ker f)^2 → κ. Its kernel is the cotangent ideal, whose square is zero (AlgHom.ker_kerSquareLift and Ideal.cotangentIdeal_square). Formal smoothness of κ/k lifts the identity of κ through q, giving a k-algebra section σ, by Algebra.FormallySmooth.liftOfSurjective and comp_liftOfSurjective. This packages the transcendence-basis lifting and simple-root adjustment of the source.

Mathlib retractionKerCotangentToTensorEquivSection converts σ to an R-linear left inverse l of KaehlerDifferential.kerCotangentToTensor k R κ. This equivalence packages the square-zero conormal retraction and the differential comparison with R/(ker f)^2. Hence the cotangent map is injective by Function.LeftInverse.injective. Compose with Ideal.Cotangent.equivOfEq for ker(residue)=maximalIdeal to obtain precisely the stated injection.
